prompt: In a flat vector illustration, a serene mountain campsite unfolds with distinct characters and items. On the left side of the composition, a woman in a yellow raincoat stands tall. Next to her sits a large grey backpack. She is handing a metal mug to a boy in a blue cap who stands nearby. The boy in a blue cap is looking at the steaming contents of the mug. In the center foreground, a man in a red scarf sits on a wooden log. Beside him rests a black cast iron pot. A small orange cat sleeps peacefully on top of the black cast iron pot. To the right of the man in a red scarf, a girl in pink boots points toward the distant peaks. Her gesture directs the attention of a dog with floppy ears standing beside her. The dog with floppy ears is looking at the direction she indicates. Behind them, a green tent is pitched firmly on the grass. A brown bear watches from the tree line in the background. Near the tent entrance, a pair of hiking boots lies abandoned. A lantern hangs from a branch above the tent. A coil of rope sits on a rock near the fire pit. There is no smoke rising from the fire pit. There is no water visible in the scene. The woman in a yellow raincoat is positioned on the left. The man in a red scarf is located in the center. The girl in pink boots stands on the right. The scene captures a moment of calm preparation and observation among the group.
